changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO reference.ref_postcode_office (postcode, branch_id, sort_order) SELECT v.postcode, v.branch_id, 10 FROM ( SELECT '83000' AS postcode, 4 AS branch_id UNION ALL SELECT '05000', 11 UNION ALL SELECT '15000', 12 UNION ALL SELECT '75000', 13 UNION ALL SELECT '70000', 14 UNION ALL SELECT '25000', 15 UNION ALL SELECT '30000', 16 UNION ALL SELECT '01000', 17 UNION ALL SELECT '88000', 18 UNION ALL SELECT '93000', 19 UNION ALL SELECT '20000', 20 UNION ALL SELECT '87000', 21 UNION ALL SELECT '62000', 1 UNION ALL SELECT '53300', 5 UNION ALL SELECT '61200', 1 UNION ALL SELECT '80300', 4 UNION ALL SELECT '10400', 5 ) v WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM reference.ref_postcode_office po WHERE po.postcode = v.postcode AND po.branch_id = v.branch_id );

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO registration.reg_area_code (branch_id, postcode, area_code, area_name, is_active) SELECT po.branch_id, po.postcode, CASE po.branch_id WHEN 1 THEN 'W11' WHEN 2 THEN 'A37' WHEN 3 THEN 'A43' WHEN 4 THEN 'J02' WHEN 5 THEN 'P02' WHEN 10 THEN 'F75' WHEN 11 THEN 'K01' WHEN 12 THEN 'D01' WHEN 13 THEN 'M01' WHEN 14 THEN 'N01' WHEN 15 THEN 'C01' WHEN 16 THEN 'F01' WHEN 17 THEN 'R01' WHEN 18 THEN 'S01' WHEN 19 THEN 'Q01' WHEN 20 THEN 'T01' WHEN 21 THEN 'L01' ELSE 'A31' END, CASE po.branch_id WHEN 1 THEN 'Kuala Lumpur (OPA)' WHEN 2 THEN 'Shah Alam (OPA)' WHEN 3 THEN 'Petaling Jaya (OPA)' WHEN 4 THEN 'Johor Bahru (OPA)' WHEN 5 THEN 'Seberang Perai (OPA)' WHEN 10 THEN 'Tapah (OPA)' WHEN 11 THEN 'Kedah (OPA)' WHEN 12 THEN 'Kelantan (OPA)' WHEN 13 THEN 'Melaka (OPA)' WHEN 14 THEN 'Negeri Sembilan (OPA)' WHEN 15 THEN 'Pahang (OPA)' WHEN 16 THEN 'Perak (OPA)' WHEN 17 THEN 'Perlis (OPA)' WHEN 18 THEN 'Sabah (OPA)' WHEN 19 THEN 'Sarawak (OPA)' WHEN 20 THEN 'Terengganu (OPA)' WHEN 21 THEN 'Labuan (OPA)' ELSE 'Malaysia (OPA)' END, TRUE FROM reference.ref_postcode_office po WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM registration.reg_area_code ac WHERE ac.branch_id = po.branch_id AND ac.postcode = po.postcode AND ac.is_active = TRUE );
